text_to_speech: in the outdoors matches should not be regarded as a mere convenience they can become an important survival tool we'll return to show you how to protect your matches i personally recommend good quality strike anywhere wooden matches for outdoor use keep your matches in a waterproof container you can waterproof matches by coating them with clear fingernail polish or by dunking them in hot wax be sure to coat the stick because it can absorb water that can destroy the head when you light a match shield it with your hand until the stick catches fire to prevent the breeze from blowing it out remember matches don't stop fires people do

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In the outdoors, matches should not be regarded as a mere convenience.
They can become an important survival tool.
We'll return to show you how to protect your matches.
High-personally recommend good quality strike anywhere wooden matches for outdoor use.
Keep your matches in a waterproof container.
You can waterproof matches by coating them with clear fingernail polish or by dunking them in hot wax.
Be sure to coat the stick because it can absorb water that can destroy the head.
When you light a match, shield it with your hand until the stick catches fire to prevent the breeze from blowing it out.
Remember, matches don't stop fires. People do.

youtube_description: In the late 1980s, Troop 160 created a series of short spots aired on local television channels, called "Outdoor Tips." It has been many years since the tips last saw the light of day... and now, thanks to modern technology, they can be seen right here on Youtube!
